sections.title: Detector
sections.description: Detector channels of the TTTR file.
Routing channels and detector that define the photon stream.

sections.title: Acquisition
sections.description: Micro-time and macro-time window of the photons that are histogrammed.

sections.label: coarsen
sections.description: Micro-time coarsening (binning) factor: neighbouring micro-time bins are summed before histogramming.

sections.label: shift [bins]
sections.description: Integer micro-time shift in bins applied to the decay histogram.

sections.title: Anisotropy (VV/VH)
sections.description: Polarization channel(s) read from the file. With VH channels set, the routing channels are the parallel (VV) detectors.

sections.label: VH chs
sections.description: Routing channels of the perpendicular (VH) detectors, comma-separated. Empty: the routing channels give one decay and the polarization settings are not used.

sections.label: pol.
descriptions: VV and VH stacked for anisotropy analysis.
sections.description: Decay(s) built from the VV (routing) and VH channels.

sections.label: g-factor
sections.description: Detection-efficiency ratio (g-factor) between the parallel and perpendicular channels; weights VH in the VM sum and is attached to a VV/VH pair for the fit.

sections.label: VH shift [bins]
sections.description: Integer shift (bins) applied to the VH decay relative to VV.
